phenotypes.hpo_label: Abnormality of the shoulder girdle musculature

records.segregation: co-segregated with the disease in the family
quotes: In a large consanguineous family with OFCS from Turkey, we performed whole-exome sequencing (WES) of a single pooled DNA sample of four affected individuals.
identified only a single novel homozygous variant, c.497G>T, located in PAX1 that co-segregated with the disease in the family.
The mutation is predicted to substitute the glycine at position 166 to valine (p.G166V) within the highly conserved paired-box domain of the PAX1 protein.

notes.statement: Pohl et al. (2013) described otofaciocervical syndrome as an autosomal recessive disorder characterized by facial dysmorphism, external ear anomalies with preauricular pits and hearing impairment, branchial cysts or fistulas, anomalies of the vertebrae and shoulder girdle, and mild intellectual disability.
quotes: Otofaciocervical syndrome (OFCS) is an autosomal recessively inherited disorder characterized by facial dysmorphism, external ear anomalies with preauricular pits and hearing impairment, branchial cysts or fistulas, anomalies of the vertebrae and the shoulder girdle, and mild intellectual disability.

notes.statement: Pohl et al. (2013) performed whole-exome sequencing on a pooled DNA sample of 4 affected members of a large consanguineous Turkish family with OFCS and identified a homozygous c.497G>T (p.G166V) mutation in the paired-box domain of PAX1 that cosegregated with disease.
quotes: we performed whole-exome sequencing (WES) of a single pooled DNA sample of four affected individuals
identified only a single novel homozygous variant, c.497G>T, located in PAX1 that co-segregated with the disease in the family.

notes.statement: In a dual luciferase reporter assay of an Nkx3-2 promoter regulatory sequence, Pohl et al. (2013) found significantly reduced transactivation by mouse Pax1 carrying the corresponding G157V mutation compared with wildtype in HEK293T cells, indicating reduced DNA-binding affinity of the mutant protein.
quotes: We observed a significantly reduced transactivation in HEK293T cells overexpressing Pax1(G157V) in comparison to Pax1(WT) expressing cells, indicating a reduced DNA-binding affinity of the mutant protein.

notes.statement: Estefanía et al. (2006) described oto-facio-cervical syndrome as characterized by trophic alterations of the face and shoulder girdle in addition to the malformations seen in branchiootorenal syndrome.
quotes: OFC is characterized by trophic alterations of the facies and shoulder girdle in addition to the malformations seen in BOR.

notes.statement: Estefanía et al. (2006) concluded that OFC can be caused not only by major rearrangements (the earlier hypothesis was that contiguous deletions of EYA1 and adjacent genes were responsible) but also by point mutations that alter the EYA1 reading frame.
quotes: led to the hypothesis that OFC is caused by contiguous deletions of EYA1 and adjacent genes
Our results indicate that not only major rearrangements, but also point mutations altering the EYA1 reading frame, can be found in patients with OFC syndrome.

notes.statement: Rickard et al. (2001) used a fluorescent quantitative multiplex PCR dosage assay for EYA1 exons 7, 9, and 13, combined with microsatellite marker analysis. With it they found de novo deletions of EYA1 and the surrounding region in 2 patients whose complex phenotypes included features of BOR syndrome. One of these patients had OFC syndrome and a large deletion of the EYA1 gene region, which the authors concluded showed that OFC syndrome is allelic with BOR syndrome and is a contiguous gene deletion syndrome.
quotes: We have developed a fluorescent quantitative multiplex polymerase chain reaction for three 3' exons (7, 9 and 13) of the EYA1 gene.
One patient with OFC syndrome carried a large deletion of the EYA1 gene region, confirming that OFC syndrome is allelic with BOR syndrome.

notes.statement: Rickard et al. (2001) compared the boundaries of the large deletion in the OFC patient with other reported rearrangements of the region. This narrowed the critical region for Duane syndrome to the interval between markers D8S553 and D8S1797, a genetic distance of about 1 cM.
quotes: comparison of the boundaries of this large deletion with other reported rearrangements of the region reduces the critical region for Duane syndrome (an eye movement disorder) to between markers D8S553 and D8S1797, a genetic distance of approximately 1 cM

notes.statement: Rickard et al. (2001) described OFC syndrome as clinically similar to BOR syndrome, with clinical features beyond those of BOR syndrome.
quotes: Oto-facio-cervical (OFC) syndrome is clinically similar to BOR syndrome, with clinical features in addition to those of BOR syndrome.

notes.statement: Dallapiccola and Mingarelli (1995) noted that some features of the original OFC family, including lateral cervical fistulae, had suggested that OFC syndrome might be a variant of BOR syndrome. In their sporadic patient, preauricular tags, lacrimal duct stenosis and renal malformations were absent, while distinct facial and radiographic findings and markedly downward-sloping shoulders were present. They concluded that this supports OFC syndrome being a unique, clinically recognizable entity.
quotes: Some features present in the original family, including lateral cervical fistulae, have suggested that OFC syndrome could be a variant of BOR syndrome.
the presence of distinct facial and radiographic findings and markedly downward sloping shoulders in the present patient support OFC syndrome being a unique, clinically recognisable entity.
